audience: Italian businesses and accountants who invoice clients and track payments in Fatture in Cloud

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and their due dates
useCases.text: List the unpaid invoices and their due dates. Open one to read its customer, payments and totals.

useCases.title: Review supplier expenses and their totals
useCases.text: List the received documents of a company, such as supplier expenses. Open one to read the supplier, items and totals.

useCases.title: Check cash in and out for a period
useCases.text: List the cashbook entries between two dates. Each entry shows the money in or out, with its linked documents and payment accounts.

useCases.title: Create an invoice for a client
useCases.text: Find the client, then look up the VAT types. Create the invoice with its lines. Creating it sends nothing. E-mail it or send it as an e-invoice in a separate step.

useCases.title: E-mail a finished invoice to the customer
useCases.text: Open the issued document, then e-mail it to the customer from Fatture in Cloud. The e-mail cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Find out why the SDI rejected an e-invoice
useCases.text: Read why the Italian SDI system rejected an e-invoice, with the error code and a suggested fix. Check the XML of a document before it is sent.
